title: Stacey Plaskett
extract: Stacey Elizabeth Plaskett is an American politician and attorney who is the governor-elect of the United States Virgin Islands. She has served since 2015 as the delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the United States Virgin Islands' at-large congressional district. Plaskett has practiced law in New York City, Washington, D.C., and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
